item.title: Reservations about the proposed federal prosecutor’s office
item.dc:creator: Roland Schmidt
item.description: Collect the published consultation submissions on Austria’s proposed federal prosecution authority (Bundesstaatsanwaltschaft), extract criticisms and reservations from each, group them across the corpus, and count how many submissions raise each group.

item.title: How do Parties vote in the Austrian National Council? Part II
item.dc:creator: Roland Schmidt
item.description: A follow-up that traces how parties shift their position on a government bill (Regierungsvorlage) as it moves through committee, the second reading and the third reading in the Austrian National Council — and asks where, if anywhere, those changes actually happen.
